drhp.business: Modern Threads (India) Limited (MTIL) is engaged in the textile industry, producing worsted yarn, wool tops, wool grease, polyester viscose fibre-dyed yarn, 100% polyester yarn, and lanolin. The company began in 1973 as Modern Woollens making wool and wool-blended worsted yarn, and operates its manufacturing facility in Bhilwara, Rajasthan under a Woollen Division and a Yarn Division.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Short supply of Australian wool pushed raw material prices up during the year, and cautionary statements flag raw material availability and prices as a factor that could cause actual results to differ from projections.
- Global instability and the ongoing geopolitical situation reduced international export demand and disrupted supply, cost and delivery timelines in the last quarter of the year; export outlook is described as not very optimistic due to reduced wool and blended-yarn consumption by many small customers/countries.
- Significant presence of small suppliers has reduced the company's bargaining power.
- Threat from the unorganised sector and low-cost substitute products from other countries is flagged as a factor of concern for management.
- Cautionary statements cite cyclical demand and pricing in the company's principal markets as a factor that could materially affect operations.
- Cautionary statements flag changes in Government regulations and tax regimes, in India and in the countries where the company does business, as a risk to projected performance.
- The company states its intellectual capital is its most valuable asset and any loss of it would have a significant negative impact on performance.
- Management's risk framework regularly identifies business environment risks, market fluctuations, political uncertainties, environmental factors and liquidity challenges as risks requiring mitigation.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Capture growth potential in worsted yarn through a wide product range by entering foreign markets.
- Sustain leadership for Woollen Division products in the global market while retaining existing customers and contracting new customers overseas with a different product range in worsted yarn.
- Explore new business areas/opportunities to broad-base investment and industry presence.
- Improve operational efficiency, cost reduction and better management of available financial resources across the Woollen and Yarn divisions.
- Focus spinning on fine count for better utilisation of spin capacity.
